functions.name: inspect_twilio_connection
functions.title: Inspect Twilio Voice Connection
functions.description: Read-only check of the approved Twilio account or Eden Skye number ending 1174. Does not call, text, purchase, record, or change routing. Live voice remains UNKNOWN until tested.

functions.name: send_sms
functions.title: Send SMS Message
functions.description: Send an SMS text message to a phone number via Telnyx. Use when the user asks to text, message, or notify someone via SMS. Requires the recipient's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890).

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: send_mms
functions.title: Send MMS Message
functions.description: Send an MMS message with media attachments (images, video URLs) to a phone number via Telnyx. Use when the user wants to send a multimedia message with images or files. Provide media_urls as an array of publicly accessible URLs.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

message.description: Optional text body accompanying the media

media_urls.description: Array of publicly accessible media URLs (images, video, audio) to attach

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: make_voice_call
functions.title: Make AI Voice Call
functions.description: Initiate an AI-powered voice call to a phone number via Telnyx Call Control. Use when the user asks to call someone, make a phone call, or start a voice conversation. The call connects to an AI voice agent.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Caller phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

connection_id.description: Telnyx connection ID for the call. Optional — uses default if omitted.

functions.name: send_email
functions.title: Send Email
functions.description: Send an email to one or more recipients via the connected Gmail connector. Use when the user asks to email someone, send a message via email, or distribute content. Supports plain text and HTML bodies, plus CC and BCC.

html.description: Optional HTML email body. If provided, the email is sent as multipart with both plain text and HTML.

from_name.description: Sender display name. Optional — defaults to 'XTREME Communications'.

functions.name: send_whatsapp
functions.title: Send WhatsApp Message
functions.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number via Telnyx WhatsApp API. Use when the user asks to message someone on WhatsApp.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender WhatsApp number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: send_batch
functions.title: Send Batch Messages
functions.description: Send SMS, MMS, or WhatsApp messages to multiple recipients in one call. Supports personalization with {{first_name}}, {{full_name}}, and {{company}} placeholders when recipient objects include name/company. Use when the user wants to blast, broadcast, or send messages to many people at once. Throttled at 2 messages/second by default.

recipients.description: Array of recipients. Each can be a phone number string in E.164 format (e.g. '+1234567890'), or an object {phone, name, company} for personalization.

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to system number.

throttle_per_sec.description: Messages per second rate limit. Default 2.

functions.name: check_messages
functions.title: Check Recent Messages
functions.description: Check recent SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, and email messages that were sent. Use when the user asks 'what did I send?', 'show recent messages', 'did my message go through?', or wants to see results of their communications. Returns a voice-friendly summary of recent outbound messages.

limit.description: Number of recent messages to return (default 10, max 50)

functions.name: check_inbox
functions.title: Check Inbox
functions.description: Check for incoming SMS and MMS messages received on your Twilio number. Use when the user asks 'do I have any new messages?', 'check my inbox', 'did anyone text me?', or 'what did I receive?'. Returns a voice-friendly summary of inbound messages with sender and content.

limit.description: Number of recent inbox messages to return (default 10, max 50)

functions.name: reply_to_message
functions.title: Reply to Message
functions.description: Reply to an incoming message via Twilio from your toll-free number (+18665711174). Use when the user says 'reply to them', 'text them back', 'respond to that message', or 'tell them okay'. Sends an SMS reply from your Twilio number to the specified recipient.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender number. Optional — defaults to your Twilio number +18665711174.

functions.name: capability_status
functions.title: Check Capabilities
functions.description: Check what communication capabilities are currently live and available (SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, voice, email, AI). Use when the user asks 'what can you do?', 'what's available?', or 'can you send a message?'

functions.name: run_ai_task
functions.title: Run AI Task
functions.description: Run an AI task with a natural language prompt and optionally deliver the result via SMS. Use when the user asks to generate content, analyze text, answer questions, or perform AI-powered tasks. Optionally set deliver_via='sms' and deliver_to to send the result to a phone number.

prompt.description: The AI task prompt or question

model.description: Optional model override. Defaults to fast model.

deliver_via.description: Optional delivery method. Set to 'sms' to deliver the AI result via text message.

deliver_to.description: Phone number to deliver the result to (E.164). Required if deliver_via is 'sms'.

from_number.description: Sender number for SMS delivery. Optional.

functions.name: preview_voice
functions.title: Generate AI Voice Audio
functions.description: Generate speech audio (text-to-speech) from text and return a playable MP3 URL. Use when the user asks to generate audio, create a voice message, or hear how text sounds spoken aloud.

text.description: The text to convert to speech (max 5000 characters)

language_code.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'es'). Auto-detected if omitted.
